title: A Treatise on the Preparation and Delivery of Sermons
shortTitle: On the Preparation and Delivery of Sermons
author: John A. Broadus

translation.name: A Treatise on the Preparation and Delivery of Sermons — John A. Broadus

rights: Public domain (published 1870; author d. 1895). Scan and OCR: Internet Archive.
citation: Broadus, John A. A Treatise on the Preparation and Delivery of Sermons. Philadelphia: Smith, English & Co., 1870. Public domain; Internet Archive scan.
editorialMarkers: The standard nineteenth-century American manual: the text and its interpretation, materials and arrangement (the three-point outline lives here), style, and delivery. Baptist, Southern, and of its era in every opinion; its method is still the skeleton of most Western preaching.
method: Internet Archive OCR text per volume; treatises open at a capitalised title block (“A TREATISE …”, “THE nth BOOK OF THE TREATISE …”); paragraphs by blank lines; page numbers, lone running heads and volume signatures dropped; hyphenation joined; the index and catalogue matter cut. The scan’s own damage is repaired: headings whose letters the scanner misread, the translator’s footnotes standing as paragraphs of the work, the publisher’s sales catalogue, and words split by the gutter. A letter is corrected only where the printed word is not in doubt — a token no lexicon knows with exactly one candidate; anything ambiguous is left as scanned.
